sources.role: Target Conjecture 3 uses left weak order. Source-reported Grassmannian and 1 times dominant cases cover all three conjectures; inverse fireworks covers only Conjectures 1 and 2. These reported families were not independently proved here.

sources.convention_caution: Only the recursive sentence immediately preceding equation (2.1) is identified as reversing the ascent/descent inequality. The displayed descent cases (2.1)-(2.2) and top monomial fix the convention used.
